outcome: Prevalence of intracranial hemorrhages (subdural [SDH], subarachnoid [SAH], intraventricular [IVH], intraparenchymal [IPH])
finding: SDH followed by IPH were the most common ICH in neonates with HIE, and while thrombocytopenia and deranged coagulation did not increase risk of hemorrhages, infants who received inotropes were more likely to have IPH.
